verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an in-product AI assistant that answers questions and completes tasks inside the Billing UI, and an AI feature that can draft plans, pricing, and entitlements from documents/descriptions — both are forms of AI-generated suggestions from data. However, there's no detailed documentation of proactive 'insights' (e.g., trend analysis, churn/revenue insights) and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this AI experience. Missing for 10: evidence of analytics-style AI insights (not just task completion/drafting), and third-party or user validation of the in-product AI's quality.
